name: Custom WooCommerce Discount for User- Flexible Pricing & Discount Rule
author: BeePlugin

sections.installation:
• In your WordPress Dashboard go to “Plugins” -> “Add Plugin”.
  • Search for “User Custom Discount”.
  • Install the plugin by clicking the “Install” button and activate it.
  • Go to the “Manage Customer Discount” in the left navigation menu.
  • Select user from the drop down.
  • Add / Remove rules as per requirement.
  • Select category / Sub category / products and set discount %
  • Once the user logins he will be able see the discount with deducted price.
sections.faq:
How can I upgrade to the Pro version of the Custom WooCommerce Discount Plugin?

To upgrade to the Pro version, deactivate and delete the free version, then purchase and install the Pro version. After installation, activate it by entering your license key to unlock advanced features.

What types of discounts can I create with this plugin?

You can create various types of discounts, including percentage discounts, fixed price discounts, user-role-based discounts, and quantity-based discounts for your WooCommerce store.

Can I apply discounts to specific user roles?

Yes, the plugin allows you to apply discounts to specific user roles such as wholesale buyers, VIP customers, or registered users.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce coupon codes?

Yes, the plugin integrates with WooCommerce coupon codes, allowing you to combine both discounts and coupons for greater flexibility.

Can I create cart-based discounts?

Yes, you can set up cart-based discounts that apply based on the total cart value, encouraging customers to spend more.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices, providing a seamless shopping experience across all platforms.

Can I schedule discounts to run for specific time periods?

Yes, you can schedule discounts with start and end dates, making it ideal for seasonal promotions, flash sales, or limited-time offers.

How do customers see the discounts applied?

Discounts are shown on product pages, the cart page, and at checkout, making it clear to customers what discounts are being applied throughout their shopping journey.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No, the plugin has an intuitive and easy-to-use interface, meaning you don’t need any coding knowledge to create and manage discounts.

Is the plugin compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with most WooCommerce extensions and themes. If you experience any compatibility issues, our support team is ready to assist you.

.What should I do if I face issues using the plugin?

If you encounter any issues, please visit the WordPress.org support forum for assistance, or contact the plugin’s support team through the official support channels.
sections.description:
This plugin is perfect for WooCommerce store owners. It helps you create cool discounts that can make customers want to buy more. You can create deals like “Buy One Get One Free”, set discounts by category, or offer special discounts for certain customers. It’s easy to use and makes your store more fun!

KEY FEATURES:

  • Custom Discounts: Set discounts for products, categories, or specific customers using the Free WooCommerce Discount Plugin. You can choose a fixed amount or a percentage off.

  • Bulk Discounts: Apply discounts to a whole category or group of products in just a few clicks. Perfect for special sales.

  • Buy One Get One Free: Make deals where customers get a free product when they buy one.

  • Time-Based Discounts: Set discounts for specific times, like Black Friday or holiday sales.

  • Role-Based Discounts: Offer discounts to different users, like VIP customers or wholesalers.

  • Exclusive Discounts: Show discounts only to customers who are logged in. This makes people want to sign up for your store.

  • Shipping Discounts: Add discounts to shipping costs to encourage customers to buy more.

Why Use the Free WooCommerce Discount Plugin?

  • Get More Sales: Offer discounts to attract new customers and encourage old ones to return and buy more.

  • Easy to Set Up: No need for coding skills. You can set up discounts in just a few steps.

  • Better Shopping Experience: Give special deals to people who sign up or belong to certain groups, making shopping more fun for them.

  • Works for Any Size Store: This plugin is suitable for all businesses, whether you’re just starting out or already have a big store.

  • Track Your Success: See how well your discounts are doing so you can make better choices for future sales.

View Admin Demo | View User Demo

DISCOUNT TYPES AND FEATURES

Free version features

  • User-Specific Discounts: Admins can give extra discounts to certain customers.

  • Targeted Discounts: Set discounts for certain categories, subcategories, or products.

  • Login-Only Discounts: Discounts are visible only after the user logs in.

  • Flexible Display: Discounts show in the Cart, Mini Cart, Product Loop, and Variable Products.

WEBSITE

[https://www.beeplugin.com/custom-woocommerce-discount]

PRO VERSION FEATURES

Custom WooCommerce Discount for User PRO version of the Custom WooCommerce Discount for User plugin. Unlike flat-rate discounts that only offer short-term sales boosts, personalized offers like “Discount upon Signup” create long-term relationships with your customers and increase their lifetime value.

Key Features of PRO Version:

Unlock more features with the Pro Version:

  • Discounts for Specific Users: Offer discounts only to certain customers or user roles, like wholesalers or VIPs.

  • Custom Discounts for Products, Categories, and Subcategories: Set discounts for specific items or groups of products, like 5% off electronics or 3% off T-shirts.

  • Cart Value-Based Discounts: Offer discounts based on the customer’s spending, like 5% off when they spend over $49.

  • Fixed Price or Percentage Discounts: You can offer a fixed discount or a percentage discount.

PRO VERSION LINK

https://www.beeplugin.com/plugins/

What’s New in the Free WooCommerce Discount Plugin

  • Set Discounts for All Products: Admins can now set discounts for all products based on users or roles, using either percentage or flat-rate options.

  • Cart Total-Based Discount Rules: Create discounts based on the total value of the cart.

Benefits for WooCommerce Store Owners and Developers:

  • More Flexibility: Customize your discount rules based on different things like user role, cart value, products, and more.

  • Keep Customers Coming Back: Offer discounts to new, loyal, or wholesale customers to keep them happy.

  • Easy Setup: No technical skills are needed to manage discounts.

  • Works for Any Size Store: Whether you’re a small store or a big one, this plugin will grow with you.

  • Shipping Discounts: Pair discounts with shipping offers to make customers more likely to buy.

EXAMPLES

  • Set Up Discounts for Products
    Example: Choose a customer and give them 15% off on multiple products, or set specific discounts for individual products.

  • Encourage Customers to Sign Up.
    Example: After users log in, they can see discounts like 12% off Product X and 20% off Product Y.

  • Apply Bulk Discounts to Categories/Subcategories
    Example: Set a 15% discount on all products in a selected category or subcategory with just a few clicks.

  • Set Different Discounts for Different User Roles
    Example: Assign 20% off for Retailers, 15% off for VIP Users, and 30% off for Wholesalers in selected categories, subcategories, or individual products.
